name: Stoic Pendant
flavour: Hits land softer on the one who expects them.
note: All attributes with a small flat cut to physical attack damage taken.

name: Draught Locket
flavour: It only wakes when you drink.
note: Defences, energy shield and resistances; energy shield recharges much faster during flask effect, at a slower start. Defences is written as armour, evasion and energy shield each.
drop: slower start of Energy Shield Recharge
Energy Shield Recharge Rate during Flask Effect

name: Skyrend Pendant
flavour: Every sharp moment answers with thunder.
note: Mana, lightning damage and a lightning chain spell cast on critical strike (Bob's Arc Chain stands in for the bolt). Crit chance scaling from lightning resistance dropped.
drop: Critical Strike Chance is increased by Lightning Resistance

name: Thunderpeal Pendant
flavour: The sky clears its throat.
note: Attributes, mana and a lightning chain spell cast on critical strike (lower level; Arc Chain stands in for the bolt). Crit chance scaling from lightning resistance dropped.
drop: Critical Strike Chance is increased by Lightning Resistance

name: Reaping Charm
flavour: What falls is only borrowed from the wearer.
note: Strength, chances for Dread Might and Quickening on kill and life on kill. The versions that buff nearby enemies were dropped.

name: Singed Cameo
flavour: Clean hands, warm gloves.
note: Ignite chance with damage and fire leech while ignited. The fire damage taken when igniting was dropped.

name: Glass Gambit
flavour: A bet that pays rarely and pays enough.
note: Huge critical multiplier for much less critical chance, with accuracy and evasion. Culling on crit dropped.

name: Rabbit Charm
flavour: Lucky for someone.
note: Dexterity and movement speed. The lucky-damage lines were dropped.

name: Kindling Pendant
flavour: Slow to catch, slow to leave.
note: Life, mana, a chance to freeze, shock and ignite, and longer elemental ailments on enemies. Cannot gain power charges was dropped.

name: Altar Heart
flavour: Still warm, still giving.
note: Large added fire, cold and lightning damage. The recent-vaal-skill lines were dropped.

name: Sprouting Seed
flavour: Nothing planted here stays small.
note: Mana regeneration and a percentage of life regenerated each second. The nearby-ally versions were dropped.

name: Forgebound Amulet
flavour: It takes the blow and pays you for it.
note: Armour, block, life and mana when you block and a higher block cap, at attack and cast speed cost. Reflect on block dropped.

name: Capacitor Locket
flavour: Charged, it hums. Overcharged, it hesitates.
note: Life, mana, an extra power charge, mana regeneration per power charge and reduced crit chance per power charge. Charge duration and mana-before-life per charge dropped.
drop: reduced Critical Strike Chance per Power Charge
Mana Regeneration Rate Per Power Charge

name: Stillfrost Amulet
flavour: A calm lake, and a skin of ice on it.
note: Cold damage and resistance, freeze chance and freeze duration. The damage after freezing recently was dropped.

name: Rimebite Pendant
flavour: Frost looks for the places you are already weak.
note: Cold damage and resistance with cold penetration against chilled enemies. Chill-when-hit and blind-chilled dropped.
drop: Chill Enemy for 1 second when Hit

name: Bent Hourglass
flavour: The sand runs fast and some of it runs backwards.
note: Attack, cast and movement speed with faster leech. Reduced skill effect duration dropped.

name: Ember Vein
flavour: Blood, but only the hot kind.
note: Life, strength, fire resistance and penetration, and a fire-only conversion (Avatar of Fire). The ash curse on enemies was ignored by the translator.

name: Blighted Core
flavour: Rot burns just as well as anything.
note: Large added chaos damage that can ignite, chill and shock. Attribute requirement increase and vaal-skill soul eater dropped.

name: Venomed Hook
flavour: Patience, then a second dose.
note: Life and charges on kill: frenzy and power; poison duration per power charge. The number-of-poisons conditions on the kills and the poison damage per frenzy charge were dropped.
drop: Damage with Poison per Frenzy Charge

name: Aether Girdle
flavour: Wound tight, it hums with kept charge.
note: Elemental weapon damage, mana, energy shield and physical attack mana leech per power charge. Chill and freeze duration from energy shield dropped.
drop: Chill and Freeze duration on you

name: Trickster Cinch
flavour: Looks plain. That is the point.
note: Physical damage, life and all resistances. Reduced crit damage taken and intimidation dropped.

name: Thunderhold Belt
flavour: Come in out of the weather.
note: Armour, fire and cold resistance, lightning damage and lightning leech. The flask shock chance dropped.

name: Pacifist Girdle
flavour: The fists stay closed. Everything else burns.
note: Deal no physical damage, with life, fire and cold resistance, leech against chilled enemies and faster ignite burning.

name: Quaffer's Sash
flavour: Feed the flask and it feeds you.
note: Physical damage, added physical, life and leech with flask charges and mana regeneration while a flask is active.
drop: Flask Charges gained while using a Flask
Mana Regeneration while using a Flask

name: Trophy Strap
flavour: A rare thing, taken and worn.
note: Strength, dexterity and life; gaining the mods of rare monsters you kill (trophy). The extra damage against rare monsters was dropped.

name: Unending Hide
flavour: Mends faster than you can bleed.
note: Life, huge life and mana regeneration, flat physical damage cut and an elemental resistance penalty. The armour bonus while free of ailments dropped.

name: Sparkbound Cord
flavour: A shock, once felt, makes you quicker.
note: Added lightning, damage and movement speed while shocked, with longer shock on you. Shock reflection dropped.

name: Hoarder's Sash
flavour: Everything in it was bought.
note: Stun recovery, attributes, item quantity, fire resistance, flask duration and a flat physical damage cut.

name: Stalwart Girdle
flavour: Stand long enough and they stop trying.
note: Life and cold resistance with fortify when stunning enemies. Damage per armour and evasion, and onslaught while fortified, dropped.

name: Rainband Sash
flavour: Splits the light and keeps the pieces.
note: Physical and elemental damage, added fire, cold and lightning to attacks, and resistances. The extra elemental damage while a flask is active was dropped.

name: Brawl Strap
flavour: The wide swing hits harder and the narrow one never lands.
note: Life, strength, added physical to attacks, life when stunning and a wider physical attack damage range.

name: Foundry Belt
flavour: Wealth is mostly filling things up.
note: Physical damage, strength and faster flask charge gain. The resistances at high strength dropped.
